newPlatforms.name: KDBR Dain Bramage Radio Worldwide Free Indie Upload Form
newPlatforms.country: United States (Soldotna, Alaska); the first-party route explicitly invites independent artists worldwide.
newPlatforms.submissionMethod: official first-party free embedded music-upload form with private streaming-link alternative for radio airplay and featured-artist consideration

authorizedRoute.routeType: first-party public music-submission form with optional audio/artwork upload and private streaming-link delivery
authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: Submit clean, broadcast-ready independent music for possible KDBR radio rotation and a permanent featured-artist profile.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, passive verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Review the reCAPTCHA-protected form and later permission document, confirm ownership, clean audio and track fit, then upload or send a link only after explicit owner approval.
authorizedRoute.internationalAcceptanceEvidence: The first-party KDBR page describes underground artists worldwide and promises worldwide exposure.
authorizedRoute.standardRouteFeeEvidence: The page states that submission and airplay are completely free, with zero payola or label fees.

retain ownership while granting the station permission to stream and feature the music

emails.purpose: First-party general business and contact mailbox published on the Dain Bramage Entertainment home/contact page.

adjacentEmailsExcluded: contact@dainbramageentertainment.com is retained as a general business contact only because the music page directs submissions to the embedded form
businessContact.emailStatus: The general contact mailbox is first-party published, syntactically valid, domain aligned and context aligned, but it is not designated as a music-submission mailbox.
businessContact.verification: Email verification was limited to first-party publication, syntax, domain alignment and stated purpose. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.captchaStatus: The first-party page explicitly states that the form is protected by Google reCAPTCHA. The challenge was not activated or solved.
formBoundary.loginStatus: The site navigation exposes optional account links, but the published music-submission form does not require an account or login.
formBoundary.paymentStatus: The standard submission route is published as completely free. A separate support/donation link is optional and not part of submission.
formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: Human review is required because of reCAPTCHA, direct file upload, the later permission form, rights declarations, clean-audio requirements, AI eligibility and the final upload/submission action.
rightsOrConsentFields: accepted artists receive a later permission form confirming permission to stream and feature the music
the first-party page states that the artist keeps 100% ownership

activityVerification.evidence: The KDBR page advertises a live station and current featured artists; the first-party featured-artists page lists artists currently in heavy rotation; and the linked Caster.fm station page publishes an active daily broadcast schedule from 7 AM to at least 5 PM AKST.

genreFitEvidence: The station explicitly lists hip-hop, rock, electronic, pop, metal, R&B, indie and lo-fi.
Its featured-artist page includes artists from Austria, Brazil, the United Kingdom and the United States, supporting the worldwide-facing claim.
MarcsMusic electronic, bass, pop, hip-hop, reggae-adjacent and experimental tracks may fit after a human confirms clean-edit suitability.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is active, worldwide-facing and free, but the embedded form uses reCAPTCHA and direct uploads, successful applicants receive a separate permission form, clean and rights requirements must be confirmed, AI eligibility is unpublished, and any upload or final submission requires explicit owner approval.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Searches in the accessible repository code-search surface for KDBR, Dain Bramage and the canonical domain returned no match before creation.
deduplication.consolidation: The embedded upload form, private-link alternative, later permission form, featured-artist profile and general contact mailbox are consolidated as one canonical KDBR opportunity.

notes: One KDBR opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No form was filled, no file was uploaded, no permission form was signed, no login was used, no CAPTCHA was solved and no payment or submission action was completed.
